en: Black-and-white aerial photograph showing a large rural farm complex surrounded by fields and forest. Several sizable white wooden buildings and barns form a courtyard, with additional houses and landscaped garden areas with trees and circular features such as lawns or flowerbeds. A small road runs along the front edge of the property. The lower left text reads "Berger, Elverum" and the lower right text reads "Flyvefoto: Widerøe & Bjørneby".
